thread.title: Dow tumbles nearly 500 points, extend earlier decline after weaker-than-expected manufacturing report - MarketWatch

author: Mark DeCambre
title: Dow tumbles nearly 500 points, extend earlier decline after weaker-than-expected manufacturing report - MarketWatch
text:
U.S. stock indexes, already battered by bearish Apple news, extended Thursday morning declines, and touched session lows after a report on manufacturing came in softer than expected. The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -1.91% was down 652 points, or 2.8%, at 22,695, the S&P 500 index SPX, -1.54% retreated 2.4% at 2,450, while the Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, -1.96% declined 2.8% at 6,480. The further intraday losses came after the ISM manufacturing survey showed a decline to 54.1 in December from 59.3 in the previous month. Consensus estimates were for an ISM reading of 57.9. A reading of 50 or above indicates improving conditions Losses also came amid a market unsettled by a late-Wednesday report from Apple Inc. AAPL, -8.28% which announced a rare cut to its sales forecast, citing weakness in China's economy.
